issue.title: Proposal: Kit, doc-kit's mascot, and a tagline for the site
issue.body: Hey folks 👋 On #1192 we agreed the branding needs its own discussion, so here's a proposal for it. The PR uses all of this for now, and I'm happy to swap any of it for whatever we land on here. ## Kit A cat called Kit, after doc-kit. It's a flat head, so it works as a mark from a 16px favicon up to the home page's hero, in both color schemes, and it has a couple of poses for the spots where the site can be a bit playful: asleep on the 404 page, and peeking over the home page's last section. On the PR the drawings live in `www/theme/components/Brand.jsx` and `www/public/`. ## Tagline The home page's headline is a placeholder for now, "The docs toolkit for APIs." A few other ideas: - The docs toolkit for APIs. - API docs from plain Markdown. - Write it once, get every format. - The toolkit behind the Node.js API docs. ## Colors The site sticks to the neutral greys doc-kit's default theme already uses, no green, so it doesn't read as a Node.js page out of the box. What do y'all think? cc @avivkeller

comment.body: I know I was/am extremely critical of the Node.js mascot, I want to also make sure to give feedback when my opinion is positive: this is great, I love this mascot _a lot_.
